title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
summary: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.

title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
summary: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.

title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
summary: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.

title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
summary: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.

title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
summary: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.

title: Bitcoin holds below $70K as stocks slip despite a cooler US PPI print
summary: Bitcoin was down about 4% on the day amid a tepid market reaction to October’s US PPI reading, which came in below expected levels.

title: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
summary: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.

title: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
summary: A $5.8 million Bitcoin options loss pushed Nakamoto’s quarterly operating revenue below zero, while the company extended repayment of $60 million in Kraken debt to 2027.

title: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe
summary: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.
